intro.name: The lesson
intro.text: (Child), a child in the village, has been testing the patience of the adults. (Parent), the adult currently responsible for guiding (child.him/her), decides it is time to teach an important lesson.

a1.text: Truth with Kindness: (Child) admits to accidentally spilling berries and helps clean up. (Parent) praises the honesty and explains that truth and kindness belong together.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no game has child traits; the trait is told by the outcome itself

a2.text: The Painfully Honest Critic: At the village meal, (Child) announces that the cook's stew tastes like "wet sandals." "But you said always to tell the truth!" (Parent) blushes.

text_only.what: NO GAIN until a successful follow-up lesson
text_only.reason: no gain now; a later lesson is a state no game keeps (rule 9)

a3.text: The Gentle Correction: After the embarrassing comment, (Parent) explains how to speak honestly without being unkind. (Child) apologizes and tries again.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no game has child traits; the trait is told by the outcome itself

a4_1.text: The Little Investigator: (Child) begins asking everyone whether they are telling the truth. (Parent) must teach the difference between honesty and accusing people without reason.

text_only.what: NO GAIN if uncorrected; MODERATE if corrected
text_only.reason: the popup resolves at once: corrected or not, equally likely
